comment: What Nerotech's machines do in code, for the arbitrage guard. Harmless when Nerotech is not installed.

output_bonus.comment: The Advanced Ore Processor gives one more dust per operation than the recipe says.

conversions.comment: A Scrubber turns a filter cartridge into a dirty filter; ore processing then turns that into iron dust.
The whole loop in one step: 2 iron ingots and 6 paper make 4 cartridges, which end as up to 8 iron dust.
